Whether you’re looking for a new friend or a new sale, social media is the ideal place to build connections, in every sense of the word. So, why do we keep treating it like a magazine, made solely for people to flip through and discard? Posting Canva graphic after Canva graphic listing out the deliverables of your services isn’t ever gonna be *the thing* that makes Instagram finally work for you. The real fun (and the real conversions !) happens when you approach it with the intention of fostering relationships, making friends, and growing a true community full of people you’re excited to (virtually) hang out with.
